en-US.name: SolarGrid
en-US.summary: Control your SolarGrid solar meters and check your energy balance by voice.
en-US.description:
Link your SolarGrid account to switch your solar meters on and off, run your energy routines, and ask for your balance and today's usage.

Try: "Alexa, turn off the shop meter", "Alexa, turn on Night Saver", or "Alexa, ask Solar Grid what's my balance".
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Solar Grid what's my balance
Alexa, ask Solar Grid how much energy I used today
Alexa, ask Solar Grid to run Night Saver

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Link with a testnet wallet that owns at least one meter. Use the consent page to share the meter with control permission.
